title: Cleaning Sublimit Allowance — Listings Cleaning Fee Bands by HostCover Deep-Cleaning Sublimit
content:
# Cleaning Sublimit Allowance

*Band table for Roamhaven Listings, read against the listing's Host Damage Protection (HostCover) plan.*

On top of the standard cleaning-fee ceiling, a listing may carry a cleaning sublimit allowance, worked out on the day of the cleaning-fee reset. It reads the deep-cleaning sublimit — the most paid on one deep-cleaning claim — of the HostCover level that the listing's active Host Damage Protection (HostCover) plan holds. The allowance is added to the listing's cleaning-fee ceiling.

| Deep-cleaning sublimit of the HostCover level on the listing's active plan | Cleaning sublimit allowance |
|---|---|
| at most $500.00 | $20.00 |
| above $500.00 and at most $1000.00 | $10.00 |
| above $1000.00 | none |

## Band edges (hypothetical sublimits)

- $500.00 sits in the first band: $20.00.
- $500.01 and $1000.00 sit in the second band: $10.00.
- $1500.00 sits above $1000.00: no cleaning sublimit allowance.
